drhp.business: InfoBeans delivers AI-led product engineering, application modernisation and enterprise platform services to large enterprises across industries, combining Agentic AI, data engineering and its own SDD accelerator with consulting and implementation practices built around the Salesforce and ServiceNow ecosystems. Founded in 2000 in Indore and listed since 2017, it operates from four Indian locations (Indore HQ, Pune, Chennai, Bengaluru) and global offices in Silicon Valley, Frankfurt and Dubai, with a team of roughly 1,790 members. sk.overview: Broadcasting and streaming is a segment of the global media & entertainment (M&E) industry undergoing a structural shift to a 'new video economy' - the transition from traditional cable/DTH to internet-delivered video (OTT, FAST, CTV). The shift is characterised by fragmentation of viewership, globalisation of content, and a move to ad-supported models, and it is driving M&E companies to adopt cloud-native, purpose-built streaming-video software for production, preparation, distribution and monetization.
